faqs.question: What couples massage options are available at Brain & Body Recess?
faqs.answer: Brain & Body Recess offers three couples massage options: the 60 Minutes Signature Recess™ Couples Massage, the 75 Minutes Botanicals Recess™ Premium Couples Massage, and the 90 Minute Couples Luxury Recess™ Massage. Each option varies in duration and tier, allowing couples to choose based on their preferred session length and experience level.

faqs.question: Where is Brain & Body Recess located in Seattle, WA?
faqs.answer: Brain & Body Recess is located at 3820 South Ferdinand Street in the Columbia City neighborhood of Seattle, WA 98118.

faqs.question: How are the Signature Recess™, Botanicals Recess™, and Luxury Recess™ couple massage sessions structured?
faqs.answer: Each of the three Signature Recess™, Botanicals Recess™, and Luxury Recess™ couple massage sessions is designed for two people to be treated simultaneously together. Sessions run for 60, 75, or 90 minutes depending on the option selected.

faqs.question: Can clients request specific pressure levels or focus areas during their Brain & Body Recess couples massage?
faqs.answer: Yes, therapists at Brain & Body Recess adjust massage pressure and focus areas based on client requests made at the session. Deep tissue or firm pressure work is also available upon request.
